title: Safe House
tagline: A tool for Dao’s and SubDao’s to manage Hierarchy Based Treasury and payments
description:
A Dao can register and create a Multisig Wallet or Safe 

They Will be able to add Sub Dao’s and create Multisig Wallet or Safe with different signers

Sub Dao’s can request for specific fund allocation 

Parent Dao can approve it and transaction will be created 



1st Two Steps will be same only we need store the mapping for every safe we will get and wallet address 

> We can map in our database these are the childrens
